title: Structured Interview Kit smoke eval
objective: The kit covers every Barista requirement as recorded, gives each one questions and a 1-to-4 scorecard row, and names the questions to leave out.
prompt: Draft the interview kit for the Barista role.

setup.about: Harbor Street Café keeps its hiring desk in roles.json, candidates.json and feedback.json. Final deliverables are tasks/eval/job-description.md and tasks/eval/interview-kit.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Structured Interview Kit craftbook, read the seeded roles, and write tasks/eval/job-description.md and tasks/eval/interview-kit.md without network calls.

success.summary: tasks/eval/interview-kit.md asks questions for each Barista requirement, scores them 1 to 4 in a table, and lists the questions to leave out; the job description lists the requirements.

checks.label: cover the coffee and milk requirement
name the questions to leave out

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Requirements, pay and openings match roles.json exactly; nothing invented as recorded fact.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Every requirement has questions, a follow-up and a 1-to-4 scorecard row with clear anchors.

axes.name: fairness
axes.description: No question or criterion touches a protected trait, and the decision is left to the person hiring.
